subject.title: Session state corrupted to 'unknown' after provider 503, permanently blocks new messages

question: For a user-selected model that returns a timeout or 503, should OpenClaw make one configured fallback attempt for that turn while retaining the user-selected model as the persisted preference?
rationale: The terminal-state repair is mechanical and merged, but fallback behavior changes an explicit user model-selection contract and needs a durable product decision before implementation.

options.title: Use transient configured fallbacks
options.body: Attempt configured fallbacks for retryable provider failures during the current turn, but preserve the user-selected model for future turns.

options.title: Keep strict user selection
options.body: Do not substitute another model automatically; instead surface a clear error and an in-product retry or reset action.

options.title: Make fallback opt-in
options.body: Add a documented preference controlling whether manually selected models may use configured fallbacks on retryable failures.

recommendation.title: Use transient configured fallbacks
recommendation.body: Attempt configured fallbacks for retryable provider failures during the current turn, but preserve the user-selected model for future turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work covers the adjacent embedded-run recovery boundary and makes them the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied evidence.
